instruction: Candid outdoor full-shot photograph of a sunny park with green grass and tall trees. Standing in a line from left to right are the East Asian man in the red 'T' t-shirt (R3), the woman in the navy 'E' t-shirt (R4), the Black woman with an afro in the red 'A' t-shirt (R6), and the bald man in the navy 'M' t-shirt (R2). The East Asian man (R3) and the woman (R4) have their arms around each other's shoulders and waists while raising their other arms high. The Black woman (R6) and the bald man (R2) stand beside them, gesturing outwards with open hands. All four smile happily at the camera under bright, natural daylight.
